repo.description:
### Impact

A vulnerability in the content API allowed unauthenticated visitors to leak gated post content.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v4.0.0 up to v6.63.0.

### Patches

v6.63.0 contains a fix for this issue.

### How to update

For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References

We thank Itamar Peretz of [Versa](https://versapt.ai/), [pptx704](https://github.com/pptx704), Ethan Wilkins of Armadin, Pedro Pinho, and [evertrustai](https://github.com/evertrustai) for disclosing this vulnerability responsibly.

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, email us at [security@ghost.org](mailto:security@ghost.org).
